messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-29, the resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-04-29 to 2025-12-01; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-03-03, storage for the resizer's original uploads doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2]
- As of 2026-03-03, Team Dune decided the resizer will keep original uploads for only 90 days. [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service is owned by Team Dune, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2026-05-04, Team Boreal still owns the catalog service. [valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- As of 2026-02-10, the reports pipeline is owned by Team Cinder, which took it over from the Ember team. [decision; valid 2026-02-10 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-10-reporting]
- As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-20, Team Dune owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-06-16; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
    earlier: Team Cinder owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]

Question: Who owns image-resizer today?
